recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add the retired extension or its old migration note to current core. If maintainers want long-term legacy guidance for users of the removed ballot extension, handle that as a separate human/editorial or extension-pack decision rather than as a FHIR-32315 core fix.
issue_request: FHIR-32315 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It originally requested value-set changes and removal of a description slice on the ResearchStudy relatesTo extension, but the final resolution changed direction after FHIR-32973: remove the extension because ResearchStudy relationship modeling made it unnecessary, while temporarily noting the prior extension for known adopters.
initial_application: Commit 0ee60e33062c6b01a988523af8a6d38f3e7a4d67 removed source/researchstudy/structuredefinition-extension-researchStudy-relatesTo.xml and its IG reference. Commit dcb559de39164b7bc3aace21fe57cbaf57e13cc8 then added the requested temporary deprecated-extension note linking to the May 2021 extension definition.
additional_context: FHIR-38076 later published a ResearchStudy content-page rewrite that removed the temporary deprecated-extension note. FHIR-49760 later removed ResearchStudy.relatedArtifact for R6 and added the current ResearchStudy.relatesTo backbone. FHIR-50710 later moved ResearchStudy.relatesTo.type to the THO Artifact Relationship Type value set. The FHIR Extension Pack contains a generic relatesto-classifier extension, but not the retired ResearchStudy-specific extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current core no longer contains the retired extension or its description slice, and the active in-scope ResearchStudy.relatesTo element already carries current relationship modeling and binding. Re-adding the old transitional note would restore stale R5-ballot guidance removed by a later published page update.
